issue.title: Add provider checkpoints and thread rollback across server, contracts, and chat UI
issue.body: ## Summary - Add checkpoint APIs to provider contracts and WebSocket methods: `providers.listCheckpoints` and `providers.revertToCheckpoint`. - Implement Codex thread snapshot read/rollback support in `CodexAppServerManager` via `thread/read` and `thread/rollback`. - Add checkpoint derivation and revert logic in `ProviderManager`, including validation and unknown-session handling. - Wire checkpoint loading/revert actions into `ChatView` with a header menu and guarded UI states. - Add store support for `REVERT_TO_CHECKPOINT` to reset runtime/thread state and trim messages to the selected checkpoint. ## Testing - Added unit tests for Codex thread read/rollback behavior in `apps/server/src/codexAppServerManager.test.ts`. - Added unit tests for checkpoint listing/revert flows in `apps/server/src/providerManager.test.ts`. - Added WebSocket RPC coverage for unknown-session checkpoint errors in `apps/server/src/wsServer.test.ts`. - Added schema tests for checkpoint input/result validation in `packages/contracts/src/provider.test.ts`. - Added reducer test for checkpoint state reversion in `apps/web/src/store.test.ts`. - Runtime execution of lint/tests: Not run (not provided in commit context). --- --- > [!NOTE] > **Medium Risk** > Introduces new stateful rollback behavior and filesystem mutations (git restore/clean/reset) tied to provider events, which could affect user workspaces and session consistency if edge cases are missed. > > **Overview** > Adds **provider checkpoint APIs** end-to-end: new contracts + WS RPC methods for `providers.listCheckpoints` and `providers.revertToCheckpoint`, plus native API wiring. > > Implements Codex-side **thread snapshot + rollback** (`thread/read`, `thread/rollback`) and a new `FilesystemCheckpointStore` that captures/restores workspace state via git refs; `ProviderManager` derives checkpoint metadata from thread turns, auto-captures filesystem checkpoints on session start and `turn/completed`, and on revert validates inputs, optionally restores/prunes filesystem checkpoints, and rolls back Codex turns under a per-session lock while emitting checkpoint filesystem errors as provider events. > > Updates the web app to expose a **Checkpoints menu** in `ChatView` and adds a `REVERT_TO_CHECKPOINT` reducer action to reset runtime/session state and trim messages/events to the selected checkpoint; tests added across server, contracts, websocket routing, filesystem store, and UI store. > > Written by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/dashboard?tab=bugbot) for commit e448221739588dcdbf08b975ea3ec307db456420. This will update automatically on new commits. Configure [here](https://cursor.com/dashboard?tab=bugbot). ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * List and view conversation checkpoints with turn/message counts. * Revert conversations to a selected checkpoint. * Checkpoints menu added to chat header with loading and revert actions. * **Tests** * Added comprehensive tests for checkpoint listing, revert flows, filesystem checkpointing, and WebSocket errors for unknown sessions.

comments.body:
Greptile Summary

This PR adds provider checkpoint (thread snapshot) support across the full stack: Zod contracts, Codex JSON-RPC integration (`thread/read` / `thread/rollback`), server-side checkpoint derivation, WebSocket routing, a client-side reducer action, and a Checkpoints header menu in `ChatView`. The feature is well-structured, test coverage is solid across all layers, and the contract definitions are appropriately validated. Key concerns to address before merging: - **TOCTOU race in `revertToCheckpoint`** (`providerManager.ts`): `readThread` and `rollbackThread` are two separate non-atomic RPC calls. A new turn completing between them makes `numTurns` stale, causing the rollback to land at the wrong turn index. - **`loadCheckpoints` starts a new session as a side effect** (`ChatView.tsx`): calling `ensureSession()` to read checkpoints can unintentionally create a Codex session when the user simply opens the menu. Checkpoint listing should be read-only. - **Concurrent revert guard uses stale closure state** (`ChatView.tsx`): rapid double-clicks can bypass the `isRevertingCheckpoint` guard due to React's asynchronous state batching; a `useRef` guard would make the check synchronous.

Confidence Score: 3/5

- This PR is not yet safe to merge — a TOCTOU race in the server-side rollback and an unintended session-creation side effect in the client need to be resolved first. - The feature is well-architected and test coverage is thorough, but there are two functional bugs: (1) `revertToCheckpoint` reads the thread turn count and then rolls back in two separate RPC calls, so a concurrent turn completion between them causes the wrong rollback depth; (2) opening the Checkpoints menu when no session is active silently creates a new Codex session via `ensureSession()`, which is an unintended side effect of a read-only listing operation. There is also a minor concurrent-click guard gap in the UI. These issues can lead to data loss (wrong rollback target) or unexpected session state. - `apps/server/src/providerManager.ts` (TOCTOU race in `revertToCheckpoint`) and `apps/web/src/components/ChatView.tsx` (session side effect in `loadCheckpoints`, concurrent revert guard)

Important Files Changed

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | packages/contracts/src/provider.ts | Adds well-structured Zod schemas and TypeScript types for checkpoint listing and reversion. Schema validation is correct and non-negative integer constraints are appropriately applied. | | apps/server/src/codexAppServerManager.ts | Adds `readThread` and `rollbackThread` methods backed by `thread/read` and `thread/rollback` JSON-RPC calls. `parseThreadSnapshot` helper correctly handles response shape normalization. `rollbackThread` validates numTurns >= 1 and resets session state. Logic is clean; no critical issues. | | apps/server/src/providerManager.ts | Adds checkpoint derivation logic and `revertToCheckpoint`. The revert operation issues two separate RPC calls (`readThread` then `rollbackThread`) without locking, introducing a TOCTOU race: a new turn could arrive between the read and rollback, causing the wrong number of turns to be rolled back. | | apps/web/src/components/ChatView.tsx | Adds checkpoint menu with loading and revert handlers. `loadCheckpoints` calls `ensureSession()` which can unexpectedly create a new session just from opening the checkpoints menu. Concurrent revert guard can be bypassed due to React state update lag on rapid clicks. | | apps/web/src/store.ts | Adds REVERT_TO_CHECKPOINT reducer that slices messages, clears events, and resets session/turn state. Logic is consistent with the checkpoint contract. The `Math.max(0, Math.floor(...))` guard defensively handles edge cases. |

Sequence Diagram

```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant UI as ChatView (Browser) participant WS as wsServer participant PM as ProviderManager participant CX as CodexAppServerManager participant CXP as codex app-server (stdio) Note over UI,CXP: List Checkpoints Flow UI->>UI: onClick → loadCheckpoints() UI->>UI: ensureSession() [may start new session!] UI->>WS: providers.listCheckpoints {sessionId} WS->>PM: listCheckpoints(input) PM->>CX: readThread(sessionId) CX->>CXP: thread/read {threadId, includeTurns:true} CXP-->>CX: {thread: {id, turns: [...]}} CX-->>PM: CodexThreadSnapshot PM->>PM: buildCheckpoints(turns) PM-->>WS: {threadId, checkpoints[]} WS-->>UI: result UI->>UI: setCheckpoints(result.checkpoints) Note over UI,CXP: Revert to Checkpoint Flow UI->>UI: onRevertToCheckpoint(checkpoint) UI->>WS: providers.revertToCheckpoint {sessionId, turnCount} WS->>PM: revertToCheckpoint(input) PM->>CX: readThread(sessionId) [TOCTOU: new turn may arrive here] CX->>CXP: thread/read CXP-->>CX: snapshot (currentTurnCount) PM->>CX: rollbackThread(sessionId, numTurns) CX->>CXP: thread/rollback {threadId, numTurns} CXP-->>CX: {thread: {id, turns: [...]}} CX->>CX: updateSession(status=ready, activeTurnId=undefined) CX-->>PM: afterSnapshot PM->>PM: buildCheckpoints(afterSnapshot.turns) PM-->>WS: {threadId, turnCount, messageCount, rolledBackTurns, checkpoints} WS-->>UI: result UI->>UI: dispatch REVERT_TO_CHECKPOINT UI->>UI: store: slice messages, clear events, reset session state ``` Last reviewed commit: 57ca254
